newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets 5-23/32 pct rate on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets 5-23/32 pct rate on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England set an unchanged rate of 5-23/32 percent on repos and secured loan facilities starting on Thursday.
The rate is the same as that currently applying to the Bank's day-to-day money market repos.
The two-week maturity has maturity dates of October 24, 25 and 28 while the four-week matures on November 7, 8 and 11.
The Bank will announce the amounts to be allotted in the repos at around 1130 GMT.
